name: @projexlight/clickhouse-runtime
summary: ClickHouse client runtime for OLAP-heavy reads — trace spans, meter rollups, lineage queries. Wraps the official @clickhouse/client with pool management + typed query helpers.

hooks.name: initClickHouse
hooks.description: Initialize the ClickHouse client; runs schema migrations on the OLAP database.

hooks.name: queryRows
hooks.description: Run a SELECT + return typed rows.

hooks.name: insertBatch
hooks.description: Bulk insert (use Native format for max throughput).

scenarios.title: Service initializes ClickHouse on boot
scenarios.when_to_use: Services that need OLAP reads (meter-collector, sdk-trace query, sdk-analytics).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Client connects; migrations run if schema version is behind.

scenarios.title: Bulk-insert trace spans every 5s
scenarios.when_to_use: sdk-trace span buffer flushes every 5s via insertBatch for max throughput.
scenarios.example_code:
import { insertBatch } from '@projexlight/clickhouse-runtime';
await insertBatch({ table: 'trace.span', rows: bufferedSpans });
scenarios.expected_outcome: 10k+ rows/sec sustained. ClickHouse Native format minimizes serialization overhead.

scenarios.title: Daily rollup aggregates per-tenant SKU totals
scenarios.when_to_use: meter-collector's daily pass runs a heavy aggregate against the usage_event table.
scenarios.example_code:
import { queryRows } from '@projexlight/clickhouse-runtime';
const rows = await queryRows<RollupRow>(`SELECT tenant_id, sku, sum(units) FROM usage_event WHERE day = ? GROUP BY tenant_id, sku`, [day]);
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns typed rows. Query plan uses the partition key on day for fast scan.

compliance_posture.notes: ClickHouse holds analytics-class data only; PII-sensitive fields hashed before insert. Retention policies enforced via TTL on tables.
